findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done: When the intake or the first round predicts more than the fix file limit, Forge asks for the size allowance at fix start or before the round; forge next lists every pending owner choice first, with its exact question and how long it has waited; new and existing repos get it on upgrade
Case: normal use - A sign-off review reaches its limit, and a teammate opens the shared checkout on another machine. The sign-off record stores no wait time (src/forge/records.py:576), and this fallback reads only the current machine's event history, so `forge next` reports that the wait time is not recorded. The sign-off test seeds a `sign-off` wait event, but the sign-off flow does not create one.
findings.title: Not done: forge next omits and mis-times pending owner choices

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - Intake or a first-round worker predicts six code files. Test 1 supplies `Lane: fix` itself and does not check the instruction to keep an over-limit repair in that lane; the base intake prompt says fixes change at most five files (src/forge/templates/start.md:6). Test 3 supplies the file-naming question itself but does not check that the delivered question template asks for the file names (src/forge/templates/brief.md:233). Both tests can therefore pass after those instructions are removed, leaving the early choice or its file list unprotected.
